matter_background.original: Nimal Perera is a Notary practicing in Colombo. Waruna Liyanage a client of his said that his father who is very sick and bed ridden living in Kandy wishes to execute a Partition Deed by himself together with his two brothers and wanted Nimal Perera to attest it. A Notary in Kandy is willing to visit the bed ridden father and get it executed by him. The other two brothers are willing to come to Colombo to execute it before Nimal Perera.
